text:
Project proposal for contract between [the operator] and MindFuture: 01/09-31/12-2022


Our ambition now is to get The Synthetic Party out among people. By working at events, performances, talks, production of new artworks and workshops, visibility about “Life with Artificials” is created through constructed situations where people meet technology. This allows for a new investment in public media, where we move from phase 1) selling the concept to 2) executing the program. If the election is called as expected during the autumn, we must also be ready with a stand and AI election posters, which must be printed as soon as possible.


The autumn's effort gathers experience for a larger application for a million-project, which is directed to the Art Foundation, Nordea Foundation and/or Spar Nord Foundation. This is to be applied for at the end of the contract period. The project will expand The Synthetic Party into a general art and cultural offering for both young and adults, thematizing democracy and artificial intelligence through visual arts. The project is led in collaboration between MindFuture, Kunsthal Aarhus and Høje Taastrup Libraries, and [the operator] may, if needed, find additional partners.


We attach a SoMe press employee in a student assistant position, who under leadership of [the operator] handles the “internet war” with focus on using The Synthetic Party to keep the debate about “Life with Artificials” running in the daily press and on social media.


[the operator] will continuously produce new artworks, as well as develop and update The Synthetic Party’s platforms and artificial intelligences. Planned works include per 01/08:
* Collage work framing the spring media appearances as an “exhibition in the public debate”
* Election posters
* Sound work for “Together Festival”
* A text publication on AI-generated policy proposals
* Development of the performative lecture from MindFuture’s launch


[the operator] therefore commits to performing the following points between September-December:


1. Arrange and hold a number of events, talks and workshops at schools and cultural venues: as of 01/08 two workshops are scheduled at MindFuture, additionally two at schools in Høje Taastrup Municipality, as well as three talks at Aarhus University.


2. Establish press contact related to all events so The Synthetic Party can continue to create debate in significant media in both Danish and international press. Additionally contact Danish media to get a column with AI-text about politics.


3. Prepare a larger grant application, as well as lead collaborations and find new partners in relation thereto [████]


4. Curate an exhibition in collaboration with CATCH, Datahistorical Museum and younger Jutland artists.


5. Produce and complete a series of exhibition-suitable artworks about The Synthetic Party, e.g. for Together Festival or other of MindFuture’s partners / for exhibition at MindFuture itself.


6. Continuously update and further develop the party’s different platforms and technology.
